hyperedges.label: Authentication flow: Clerk wraps root layout; root page gate-keeps to sign-in or dashboard
Dashboard data layer: habits + completions hooks feed all dashboard-group pages
Global provider stack: ClerkProvider > ConvexClientProvider > ThemeProvider in root layout; ToastProvider > ConfettiProvider > NotificationProvider in dashboard layout
Habit CRUD Flow: Dialog + Form + Mutations
Radix UI + shadcn wrapper pattern for accessible UI primitives
HabitCard swipe/tap interaction cluster
Theme System: ThemeProvider + useTheme + ThemeToggle collaborate to manage and apply dark/light mode
Retention Flow: NudgeBanner, DailyCheckInModal, HabitGoalProgress all drive user engagement and habit completion behavior
Visual Streak Displays: StreakRibbon, StreakThread, and Heatmap all visualize habit completion history with different temporal granularities
Habit Completion → Milestone Award Flow
Push Notification Pipeline: cron → FCM action → push tokens → habits
Insights Data Flow: Convex queries → chart components
Pomodoro UI system — hook + five display/control components share PomodoroMode type and pomodoro state
Streak-to-milestone pipeline — completions feed streak calculation which drives milestone progress
Optimistic completion feedback loop — toggle fires optimistic update, on milestone shows confetti + toast
Timeline Rendering Pipeline: time-utils computes gaps, use-timeline assembles entries, TimelineView renders them with TimelineItem/TimelineGap/TimelineNowIndicator
Streak Intelligence Layer: streak-utils calculates streaks, milestone-config defines thresholds, nudges generates user messaging, streak-summary displays results
Notification Infrastructure: firebase provides FCM, NotificationProvider coordinates dual-strategy (in-app + FCM), NotificationToggle exposes unified UI control
Authentication Stack: Clerk + Convex JWT + Next.js Route Protection
Push Notification Flow: FCM + Convex Cron + Service Worker
Design System: Warm Minimal Tokens + Typography + Terracotta Accent
